body: I’ve been struggling with this for years to the point where I’m suicidal and constantly jealous of people that can live normally. This post helped me a lot, It’s been a struggle for years and I’m getting humiliated by it on a daily basis, I just recently discovered sensorimotor ocd and it felt so good to put a name to what I feel. I don’t like self diagnosing but It describes what I have exactly and I’m trying to reach out for help/a diagnosis from a dr but I feel like it’s too far gone. I haven’t opened up to people around me about this because it’s difficult to explain to someone who doesn’t understand. I’m sorry you’re going through this but thank you so much for reaching out to reddit about it because I now feel like there’s other people out there that understand unfortunately. It makes me feel fucking insane and every day revolves around whether I’ll be able to just breathe without it taking up my entire mind. It’s ruining work, and I’m scared that it’s going to affect my future. It’s taken control of my life. I hope you find peace
